senses.definition: Non-Oxford British English standard spelling of specialized.
senses.example: Second, a railway research department represents a qualified and specialised consultancy service, to provide the basis for well-informed high-level decisions regarding new designs or possible lines of development. [...] Finally, a research department is desirable to carry out the more specialised trials and testing of manufacturers' equipment prior to its acceptance by the operating personnel.

senses.definition: simple past and past participle of specialise
